brief:
Israeli warplanes struck a residential house in the Harash al-Saada area of Jenin city on Friday, killing multiple Palestinians, medical sources said. The sources provided no immediate breakdown of the casualty toll from the attack.

Ambulance crews who arrived at the scene were forced to leave by Israeli occupation forces, preventing medical personnel from conducting initial assessments of the dead and wounded, Shehab Wire reported. The expulsion of emergency responders hampered efforts to determine the full scope of casualties from the strike.
